Theorem
[Existence of an asymptotic shrinker] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0066 1. ch28:28.24\group Three-Dimensional Singularity Models

For a $\kappa $-solution and points $q_i$ at times $\tau _i\to \infty $ with bounded reduced distance, a subsequence of $(\mathcal M,\tau _i^{-1}g(\tau _i\tau ),(q_i,1))$ converges to a nonflat $\kappa $-noncollapsed shrinking gradient Ricci soliton with nonnegative curvature operator (bounded curvature in dimension three).
